name: office noun market
purpose: 58 coins from the same desk: public live market data, visitor-directed trading and a local-only desk game.

jupiter_plugin.note: Official Jupiter Plugin uses its own wallet adapter. Visitors connect their own wallet; no custody, private keys, server signing, referral fees or automatic wallet connection. Flip direction in the widget to sell.
jupiter_plugin.routing_caveat: Jupiter can route pump.fun bonding-curve coins, but quotes may fail for new or illiquid coins. Use pump.fun as a fallback.

game.disclaimer: a desk game. hours and memos stay on this device. they are not money, not tokens, and not a prize.
game.rules: Each clock-in earns one hour; every fifth files one memo. Hours unlock cosmetic coin art only. No idle accrual or offline rewards.

hook.window.OfficeNounDesk.state(): Returns a copy of { hours, memos, unlocked: string[] }; unlocked entries are tickers. Available after coins load.
hook.window.OfficeNounDesk.clockIn(): One clock-in; returns state. No transactions.
hook.window.OfficeNounDesk.reset(): Confirms with the visitor before removing the local save and resetting the desk.

game.query: ?clockin=1 performs one clock-in per page load. Can combine with trade.

transactions: No bot API signs, spends tokens or executes swaps.
